newsitem.title: INDIA: India's CARE assigns AAA to Reliance Capital.
newsitem.headline: India's CARE assigns AAA to Reliance Capital.

text.p: Indian credit rating agency CARE has assigned a CARE AAA (Triple A) rating to a proposed three-billion-rupee private placement of NCDs by Reliance Capital Ltd. (RCL).

CARE said instruments carrying this rating are considered to be of the best quality, with negligible investment risk. Debt service payments are protected by stable cash flows with good margin. While the underlying assumptions may change, such changes as can be visualised are most unlikely to impair the strong position of such instruments.
With its large base of net owned funds, low gearing, high capital adequacy ratio and good asset quality, RCL's ability to meet its debt servicing obligations remains strong, CARE said.
